body:
Verified and closing **UI-018 / #31** after all three original criteria and source/results review.

- C1: reuse accepted genuine queued/opposing/alternating intents and disposal during both native animations; the fresh public disposal-during-hide, captured-content collection and reopen regression now passes.
- C2: both missing **same-operation** regressions pass: cancel show/hide, finish that native animation, fully reset, then repeat the SAME operation. The repeated waiter stays pending until its own UIKit completion; opposite-operation coverage is not substituted.
- C3: reuse accepted concurrency, Default/IO→Main and real presenter/state replacement; fresh public captured-owner GC, plain Worker capture, and exact Main result/throwable identity checks pass.

[Actual run 41582968150](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/41582968150) at [`b73a1078`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/commit/b73a1078777f37a2bff547073aafef2e4cb58c74): **5/5 native, three fresh XML, zero failures/errors/skips, Gradle exit0**. All1,267 actual own-Git before/after inputs, full Worker completion, six ordered lifecycle/thread observations, post-runtime/binary custody and four owned-app cleanup witnesses were reviewed. Earlier accepted methods were not replayed.

[Shared owning fix and originals](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/tree/development/preview-hardening/docs/development/evidence/current-platform-recovery-20261101/ios-modal-originals418-422) · [Same-operation coverage](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/tree/development/preview-hardening/docs/development/evidence/current-platform-recovery-20261101/ios-sheet-repeat447).

Scope: controlled iOS26.5 iPhone simulator, bounded weak-owner/Recomposer checks; not a physical-device/heap-profiler/consumer/API–ABI/security/release certificate. Three appearance warnings and the earlier missing-completion failure remain historical/unexplained. Related #28/#30/#125/#126 remain open for missing genuine interaction criteria. No package, release or deployment publication.
